edges.notes: VFIO is a Linux kernel driver framework for safe device assignment to userspace per kernel documentation.
KVM guests may attach host devices via VFIO-mediated passthrough; KVM is the hypervisor API, VFIO is the device/IOMMU assignment path.
MicroVM stacks may compose VFIO-class passthrough where supported by platform and VMM configuration (survey-level).
QEMU assigns devices via VFIO on Linux for passthrough where supported.
